header: IN THE HIGH COURT OF SINDH
DATE ORDER WITH SIGNATURE OF JUDGE
Mr. Rao Faisal Ali advocate for the petitioner.
body: Learned counsel for the petitioner, under instructions, does not press instant Petition and submits that in view of order dated 14-10-2026 passed by learned Additional Sessions Judge, Shahdadpur in Crl. Misc. Application No. 281/ 2026, he will again approach concerned Court as now he has confirmed about the place where the alleged detainee is illegally detained. Consequently, instant Petition alongwith listed application is dismissed as not pressed.
